name: ai-world-war
description: AI-WORLD-WAR: a fictional AI governance & geopolitical wargame RESEARCH SIMULATION. Not a forecasting or decision-support system.

scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm run dev -w @aiww/server & npm run dev -w @aiww/ui & wait'
scripts.start: npm run build -w @aiww/ui && npm run start -w @aiww/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/schemas && tsc --noEmit -p packages/engine && tsc --noEmit -p packages/prompts && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui
